parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: The main body of the container is a matte dark grey plastic bottle with a rectangular prism shape tapering into a cylindrical neck.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the liquid contents and provides the primary structural volume for the dispenser.
physics.Grasped_description: A parallel jaw gripper would grasp the mid-section of the rectangular body firmly from the sides.
physics.reason: Standard blow-molded or injection-molded plastic bottles are thin-walled shells enclosing air or liquid.

parts.description: The main body of the container is a matte dark grey plastic bottle with a rectangular prism shape tapering into a cylindrical neck.
parts.function: Holds the liquid contents and provides the primary structural volume for the dispenser.

parts.name: front label

physics.Basic_description: A small, flat rectangular area on the front face of the bottle, likely a label or printed region, appearing slightly distinct in texture.
physics.Functional_description: Displays branding or product information on the container surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flush to be grasped independently; a gripper would contact the underlying bottle shell.
physics.reason: Labels are effectively solid thin sheets of material adhered to the surface.

parts.description: A small, flat rectangular area on the front face of the bottle, likely a label or printed region, appearing slightly distinct in texture.
parts.function: Displays branding or product information on the container surface.

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: A ribbed, cylindrical ring at the top of the bottle neck, matching the dark grey color of the body.
physics.Functional_description: Provides threading or a locking mechanism to secure the pump head assembly to the bottle.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the rim, though the ribs might make it slippery; useful for stabilizing the bottle while unscrewing the top.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic collars are hollow cylinders with walls thick enough for threads but empty inside.

parts.description: A ribbed, cylindrical ring at the top of the bottle neck, matching the dark grey color of the body.
parts.function: Provides threading or a locking mechanism to secure the pump head assembly to the bottle.

parts.name: lock ring shell

physics.Basic_description: A small ring component situated between the collar and the pump head, likely part of the locking mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the pump assembly in place or acts as a tamper-evident band.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integrated to be grasped effectively on its own.
physics.reason: Small plastic rings are hollow structures surrounding the neck opening.

parts.description: A small ring component situated between the collar and the pump head, likely part of the locking mechanism.
parts.function: Secures the pump assembly in place or acts as a tamper-evident band.

parts.name: pump head shell

physics.Basic_description: The top actuator component, appearing as a flat-topped cylinder with vertical ridges for grip, in dark grey plastic.
physics.Functional_description: The user presses this down to dispense liquid; it houses the spring and piston mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper could press down on the top surface or grasp the sides to manipulate the dispensing action.
physics.reason: Pump heads are complex hollow moldings containing internal cavities for springs and fluid channels.

parts.description: The top actuator component, appearing as a flat-topped cylinder with vertical ridges for grip, in dark grey plastic.
parts.function: The user presses this down to dispense liquid; it houses the spring and piston mechanism.

parts.name: dip tube

physics.Basic_description: A long, thin, flexible tube extending from the bottom of the pump assembly down into the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: Draws liquid from the bottom of the container up to the pump mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flexible to be a stable grasp point; would bend under gripper force.
physics.reason: Dip tubes are thin-walled hollow pipes designed to transport fluid.

parts.description: A long, thin, flexible tube extending from the bottom of the pump assembly down into the bottle.
parts.function: Draws liquid from the bottom of the container up to the pump mechanism.

parts.name: spout shell

physics.Basic_description: A small protruding nozzle or tab on the side of the pump head/collar area, visible in the side views.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the dispensed liquid outward away from the bottle.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and fragile to be grasped; likely to break if used as a handle.
physics.reason: Nozzles are hollow channels molded into the pump head to allow fluid exit.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
